reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited clauses support it: §14.1 vests Customer Data/Customer IP ownership in Customer with only a limited processing right to Vendor, §14.2 gives Customer ownership of Deliverables with an express Vendor assignment plus personnel assignments and further assurance, §14.3 limits Vendor to its pre-existing Vendor Technology and channels embedded Vendor Technology into the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use/modify/create derivative works, and §14.4 bars joint ownership absent a signed instrument while preserving Customer's feedback rights — this meets the preferred position.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding, and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.
The deterministic check (no residual assignment of Customer Data/IP to Vendor) passes, consistent with the rationale.

Sub-preferred details (payment condition on Deliverable ownership; no express 'sublicense' word, though contractor support is permitted) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than escalated to a deviation, per the playbook's classification semantics.
